title: Reinstatement Amount — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract Computation
content:
**Recovery Desk computation basis — the reinstatement amount, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

**Amount.** The reinstatement amount is the past-due amount plus the fees due balance, which includes late charges and every repossession expense booked, less the fees a reinstatement the state period grants leaves out of its amount, rounded to the cent.

**The customer's right under a state period.** A reinstatement the state reinstatement period recorded on the contract grants, on a statement date within that period counted in calendar days from the repossession date (not counted), is the customer's right, and the returned-payment fees and extension fees posted after the same calendar day twelve months before the statement date, up to and including the statement date, are left out of its amount, never more than the fees due balance.

**Discretionary reinstatement.** Every other reinstatement is one the company grants at its discretion, offered only while no other Kestrel contract or lease of the customer is 30 days (the relationship limit) or more past due.

**Order of assembly.** Each amount added to the reinstatement amount is added once, and the amount is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Statement date | Reinstatement | Fees left out |
|---|---|---|
| Within a state reinstatement period recorded on the contract (greater than 0) | the customer's right | returned-payment fees and extension fees of the counted twelve months, at most the fees due balance |
| Outside any recorded state period, or none recorded | discretionary | none |

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

Past-due amount $1260.00 and fees due balance $1185.00 on a statement date within a 20-day state period, with a $25.00 returned-payment fee and a $30.00 extension fee posted in the counted months: $1260.00 plus $1185.00 less $55.00, that is $2390.00. On a statement date after the state period has ended, nothing is left out: $2445.00. All figures are illustrative.
